[Current Frontend Spec](README.md)

Svelte/TypeScript owns reading, editing and rebuildable views. Tauri Rust owns restricted IPC, local discovery, HTTP/SSE, credentials and durable cache/outbox. Independent Core owns Host, Scheduler, tasks, authorization and business data. Pages neither hold bearer tokens nor connect directly to Core, and do not duplicate its state machines.

```text
Svelte → bridge.ts → Tauri IPC → Rust bridge / SQLite → Core API
Svelte ← projection ← cache + cursor / transient mailbox ← HTTP + SSE
```

[main.ts](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src/main.ts) · [Connected.svelte](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src/Connected.svelte) · [bridge.ts](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src/bridge.ts) · [Rust bridge](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src-tauri/src/bridge.rs) · [storage](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src-tauri/src/storage.rs) · [sync](../../../src/secretary_desktop/src-tauri/src/sync.rs)

Normal startup opens the FE-02 connection window. Select a configured profile to connect or explicitly start Core. Closing the window ends only the client; stopping Core requires a separate confirmation. `SECRETARY_STUDY=1` opens a synthetic study, which proves neither real workflows nor full PhaseUI. Release embeds assets; the development Vite server is not a production deployment.

Sending: retain editor text → save a versioned draft → durably store the original request_id/command and clear that draft in a local transaction → clear matching editor text → submit and reconcile receipts. Show queued state, HTTP 202, command receipt and task completion separately; unknown outcomes do not automatically become new requests. Preserve text on save/queue failure. Cmd+Enter sends, Enter inserts a newline; composition and candidate confirmation never send.

Keep durable snapshots, delta cursors and transient previews separate; previews are not committed history. Reconnection in the same domain/instance can retain recent text with a reconnecting label; durable messages replace it by identity. Never mix domains. Preserve domain-specific drafts and message-ID/offset anchors across pages; scrolling does not change association scope. Loading older messages preserves reading position; jumping to latest is explicit.

Use v1.0 navigation: conversation, tasks, memory, artifacts, attention and settings. The motion gallery is for development review. Preserve ongoing work, recent artifacts and shortcut positions in the right rail; leave unimplemented features empty. Resolve relationships by server entity IDs and explain failed navigation rather than guessing by name. Blank assistant names fall back to `Secretary`; omit “main session” copy.

Notifications retain presented/read semantics: notifications at or below the initial sync watermark populate the list only; report presented for client_id after actual display. Submit read separately; it is global. Persist display records to suppress duplicate presentation after restart. Treat truncated content as a prefix, not complete JSON. These are requirements for later notification UI, not a claim that FE-02 provides the full page.
